acceptance: Inspect sqlglot >=30.23.0 BigQuery FILTER transpilation semantics (COUNT(*) FILTER, COUNT(DISTINCT x) FILTER, and all-false NULL vs 0 behavior) against benchbox/core/tpchavoc/cloud_compat.py:_rewrite_bigquery_filter.

Adapt _rewrite_bigquery_filter and tests/unit/tpchavoc/test_cloud_compat.py so both locked (30.18.0) and newer 30.x sqlglot releases preserve exact TPC-Havoc 1_v6 / 12_v7 semantics on BigQuery, or tighten the sqlglot upper bound in pyproject.toml if newer 30.x introduces a semantic regression.
context: Surfaced during PR #3003 review when comparing unlocked contributor pytest results (sqlglot 30.23.0) against the repository's locked uv environment (sqlglot 30.18.0).
description: pyproject.toml:28 declares sqlglot>=25.6.0,<31.0.0 while uv.lock pins sqlglot==30.18.0. In sqlglot >=30.23.0, sqlglot.transpile(..., read='duckdb', write='bigquery') natively rewrites aggregate FILTER (WHERE ...) before benchbox/core/tpchavoc/cloud_compat.py:_rewrite_bigquery_filter runs, causing tests/unit/tpchavoc/test_cloud_compat.py::test_bigquery_filter_rewrite_handles_count_star_distinct_and_null_semantics to fail in unlocked environments using newer sqlglot 30.x releases.
